name: zeffect_tick_reset_delay_on_hit
description: zEffect::TickResetDelayOnHit decrements an animation entry countdown for hit activation modes unless the hit node carries the skip flag.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x458bb0 has an x87 fstp flag-lift limitation. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffectAnim source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x458bb0 validates skipping hit nodes with bit 0x200 in listCountA, accepting activationMode 0 or 2, subtracting damageAmount from activationCountdown, calling zEffectAnim::SetTransformRotAndVelocity with zero transform arguments on non-positive countdown, and returning zero.
The native smoke verifies countdown subtraction, hit-node skip flag behavior, skipped mode behavior, mode 2 handling, and the non-positive countdown path with activation intentionally inert.
